minutes.headline: Cemetery Commission voted its annual town meeting appropriation and began rewriting its rules, with a draft due in April.
minutes.summary: The commission approved the January minutes and voted the annual appropriation from the sale of lots account for the next town meeting. It discussed a new-lot-buyer folder and a plan to cut the three-page rules down to one page, with a draft promised for April. Members also agreed to try meeting in person from April.

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of the January 5th, 2022 meeting as written.
Appropriate ten thousand dollars from the sale of lots account for the FY23 annual town meeting.

budget_items.topic: Annual appropriation from sale of lots account
budget_items.what_was_said: The commission must vote its annual appropriation at town meeting, funded from the sale of lots account, to cover yearly expenses and improvements.
Annual expenses are mostly static, including website hosting and maintenance paid to Rainmaker, the cemetery building bathroom and flowers.

budget_items.topic: Goodrich burial ground stone wall and gate
budget_items.what_was_said: The one improvement foreseen is a stone wall and iron gate enclosing the Goodrich burial ground on Fish Street, with free labor offered.
Members discussed the cost of a folder with inserts for lot buyers; no cost was established and Dave was asked to get rough figures.
Motion to appropriate from the sale of lots account for the FY23 annual town meeting.
A member noted the rules list a price per grave and a two-grave minimum; the chair preferred to keep case-by-case exceptions rather than write in single-grave sales.

decisions.decision: Dave to gather rough cost figures for folders and inserts for about 200 to 250 copies.
The chair will present a draft of basic rules and regulations at the April meeting.
The commission plans to meet in person in April, with the option to revert to Zoom if conditions change.

what_happened.line: The Cemetery Commission voted to appropriate a sum from the sale of lots account for the FY23 annual town meeting; the vote tally was not audible.
The commission began rewriting its rules and regulations, and the chair will present a draft of basic rules at the April meeting.
A member of the commission, Dave, was asked to gather rough cost figures for a folder with inserts for new lot buyers.
The commission plans to meet in person in April, with the option to return to Zoom if conditions change.

why_it_matters: The sale of lots account, not general tax revenue, is the source of the commission's yearly appropriation, which goes to the town meeting warrant that residents vote on.
The rewritten rules will govern how lots are sold, including the per-grave price and the two-grave minimum that members questioned, so anyone buying a lot may be affected.
watch_next: The April 2022 commission meeting, where the chair is to present the draft rules and regulations.
The FY23 annual town meeting, where the commission's appropriation from the sale of lots account goes to a vote.
